claims.text: The OSD Historical Office's Key Officials list of 7 July 2026 records Michael Powers as Acting Under Secretary of War (Comptroller)/Chief Financial Officer from 20 May 2026 to present, succeeding Jules W. Hurst III, who performed the duties of the office from 5 September 2025 to 20 May 2026.

claims.sourceText: OSD Historical Office, Key Officials September 1947-July 2026 (7 July 2026), https://history.defense.gov/Portals/70/Documents/key_officials/KeyOfficials-2026-07-07.pdf
claims.text: The same list records Powers as Deputy Under Secretary of Defense (Comptroller) from 23 December 2025 to present, so he holds the deputy office and the acting principal office at once.
